description: Add comprehensive Playwright E2E test suite covering all critical user flows with Supabase mocked at the network level

userStories.title: Scaffold Playwright project with @nx/playwright
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a working Playwright project in the monorepo scaffolded via @nx/playwright so that I can write and run E2E tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Install @nx/playwright as a dev dependency in the workspace root
Create packages/e2e directory with package.json (name: @sportsnot/e2e)
Run nx g @nx/playwright:configuration to scaffold the project, or manually create equivalent config
playwright.config.ts exists with Chromium-only project, baseURL http://localhost:4200
webServer config starts nx serve @sportsnot/web automatically before tests
project.json has e2e target using @nx/playwright:playwright executor
A placeholder smoke test exists and passes with npx playwright test
.gitignore updated to ignore test-results/, playwright-report/, blob-report/
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This must be done first — all other stories depend on the Playwright project existing. Use VITE_SUPABASE_URL=http://localhost:54321 and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=mock-anon-key as env vars for the web server.

userStories.title: Create Supabase auth mock fixtures
userStories.description: As a developer, I need reusable Playwright fixtures that mock Supabase auth so that tests can simulate authenticated and unauthenticated states.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/e2e/fixtures/auth.fixture.ts with Playwright test.extend() fixtures
authenticatedPage fixture intercepts Supabase auth endpoints and returns a valid session with mock user
unauthenticatedPage fixture intercepts Supabase auth endpoints and returns no session
Mock user data includes id, email, display_name, and avatar_url fields
Auth token refresh endpoint is mocked to prevent hanging requests
Fixtures export a custom test object that other test files import
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Intercept routes matching the VITE_SUPABASE_URL pattern. Supabase auth uses /auth/v1/token, /auth/v1/user, /auth/v1/signout endpoints.

userStories.title: Create Supabase REST and Realtime mock fixtures
userStories.description: As a developer, I need reusable fixtures that mock Supabase PostgREST and Realtime so that tests have deterministic data.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/e2e/fixtures/supabase-mock.fixture.ts with page.route() interceptors for PostgREST endpoints
Mock responses match PostgREST shape: arrays for .select(), single objects for .single(), proper error shapes
Supabase Realtime WebSocket connections are stubbed via page.routeWebSocket() or equivalent to prevent hanging
Fixtures are composable — tests can override specific route mocks while keeping defaults
Default mocks return empty arrays for list queries and 404 for single-record queries
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: PostgREST endpoints follow pattern: SUPABASE_URL/rest/v1/TABLE_NAME. Include mocks for leagues, league_members, drafts, draft_picks, rosters, player_stats_cache, team_stats_cache tables.

userStories.title: Create mock data factory functions
userStories.description: As a developer, I need factory functions that generate realistic mock data matching @sportsnot/types interfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/e2e/fixtures/data-factories.ts with factory functions
createMockUser() returns a valid User object with sensible defaults
createMockLeague() returns a valid League with invite_code, commissioner_id, status
createMockLeagueMember() returns a valid LeagueMember with team_name and total_points
createMockDraft() returns a valid Draft with draft_order and status
createMockDraftPick() returns a valid DraftPick with player_id, position, pick_number
createMockRoster() returns valid Roster entries for a full team (5F, 3D, 1G, IR slots)
createMockPlayerStats() and createMockTeamStats() return stat cache entries
All factories accept partial overrides to customize specific fields
Factories import and match types from @sportsnot/types
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use realistic NHL player names and team IDs. Scoring: goals=1pt, assists=1pt, wins=2pts, shutouts=4pts.

userStories.title: Create page object models for complex pages
userStories.description: As a developer, I need page object models so that tests use semantic methods instead of brittle selectors.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/e2e/page-objects/ directory
DashboardPage class with methods: getLeagueCards(), getCreateLeagueCTA(), getJoinLeagueCTA(), navigateToLeague(id)
DraftPage class with methods: getAvailablePlayers(), filterByPosition(pos), searchPlayer(name), pickPlayer(name), getMyRoster(), getCompareTray()
RosterPage class with methods: getActiveSlots(), getIRSlots(), getTotalPoints(), activateIR(playerName)
StandingsPage class with methods: getMemberRows(), getCurrentUserRow(), exportCSV()
Each page object takes a Playwright Page in constructor and exposes locators via data-testid or accessible roles
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use Playwright's getByRole(), getByTestId(), getByText() locators. If data-testid attributes don't exist in the app yet, use role-based or text-based selectors as fallback.

userStories.title: Add Playwright E2E tests to GitHub Actions CI
userStories.description: As a developer, I want Playwright tests to run automatically in CI on every pull request so regressions are caught before merge.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Playwright E2E job to existing CI workflow in .github/workflows/ or create dedicated e2e.yml workflow
CI installs Playwright browsers via npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
CI builds the web app with nx build @sportsnot/web before running tests
Playwright runs against the built output using a static file server, not dev server
Test results HTML report and trace files on failure are uploaded as CI artifacts via actions/upload-artifact
CI job fails the PR if any Playwright test fails
Playwright browser binaries are cached via actions/cache on ~/.cache/ms-playwright path
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Environment variables VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY must be set in the CI environment with mock values.
